faqItems.q: Do you show prices on the website?
faqItems.a: No. The website is a catalogue, so prices are shared on enquiry. Message us on WhatsApp with the design name or catalogue reference and we will send you a quote.
From a few dozen to several thousand pieces per design. Tell us the design and the quantity and we will confirm.

faqItems.q: Can you match a specific colour?
faqItems.a: Yes. Share a reference photo or your palette and we will match it in the sample.

faqItems.q: Do you deliver outside West Bengal?
faqItems.a: Yes, we dispatch across India. Tell us where it needs to reach and we will confirm the arrangements.

faqItems.q: How long does an order take?
faqItems.a: It depends on the design and the quantity. Share the date you need it by and we will confirm whether we can meet it.

faqItems.q: How do I enquire about a design?
faqItems.a: Open the product and use its Enquire on WhatsApp button, or use the enquiry form below. Include the catalogue reference so we know exactly which design you mean.

about.title: About JHALAR
about.intro: JHALAR is a small maker of jhalars and hanging decor based in Howrah, West Bengal. Every design in this catalogue is handmade in our own workshop, and each enquiry is answered directly over WhatsApp or phone.
